mainEntity.name: Where is Cape Cod Cannabis located?

Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary is located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667. Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational dispensary serving residents and visitors alike in Barnstable, Bourne, Brewster, Chatham, Dennis, Eastham, Falmouth, Harwich, Hyannis, Mashpee, Orleans, Provincetown, Sandwich, Truro, Wellfleet, Yarmouth and beyond.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod, Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.

mainEntity.name: What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal.

 

Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired.

 

Note: We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.

 

At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vapes, tinctures, topicals, CBD and concentrates. Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.

 

Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.

 

We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.

 

Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.

 

Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute:

 

•  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).

•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.

•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).

•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.

•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.

•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables.

 

CBD = No Limit

Topicals = No Limit

Accessories = No Limit

mainEntity.name: Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.

We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay. A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience.

 

Note: ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.

 

Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.

 

PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order.

 

We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

blocks.text: Trusted by Cape Cod Residents and Visitors Since 2021

blocks.html:
Choosing a cannabis dispensary is about more than finding the closest location. It’s about finding knowledgeable people, quality products, and a place you can trust.

Since opening in 2021, Cape Cod Cannabis has proudly served Cape Cod residents and visitors with a commitment to education, exceptional customer service, and responsible cannabis retail. Conveniently located in the Route 6 shopping plaza in South Wellfleet, we welcome customers from Provincetown to Sandwich and beyond, and everywhere in between.

Whether you’re visiting Cape Cod for a weekend getaway or you’re a year-round resident, our goal is simple: provide a welcoming, informative, and comfortable shopping experience while helping every customer make confident, informed cannabis decisions.

At Cape Cod Cannabis, trust is earned through consistency, transparency, and a genuine commitment to our customers.

We believe every customer deserves friendly service, knowledgeable guidance, and access to quality recreational cannabis products in a welcoming environment. Whether you’re exploring cannabis for the first time or have years of experience, our team is here to answer your questions, explain your options, and help you find products that best fit your preferences.

Since 2021, we’ve built lasting relationships with thousands of customers by focusing on education before recommendations, honesty before sales, and exceptional service during every visit.
Flower • Pre-Rolls • Edibles • Vaporizers • Concentrates • Tinctures • Topicals • CBD • Seeds • Accessories • Apparel

Our customers consistently describe their experience at Cape Cod Cannabis as friendly, welcoming, and informative.

Across hundreds of Google reviews, customers frequently mention:

  • Friendly and welcoming staff
  • Knowledgeable product recommendations
  • One of Cape Cod’s largest selections of cannabis products
  • A comfortable experience for first-time visitors
  • Convenient Route 6 location with free parking
  • Easy online ordering and in-store pickup
  • Professional, educational approach to cannabis
  • Great product variety and value
  • Helpful guidance without pressure
  • A shopping experience that’s always worth the trip

These recurring themes reflect the experience we strive to provide every day.

Responsible and informative education is at the heart of everything we do.

Cannabis affects everyone differently, which is why we believe informed customers make better decisions. Our knowledgeable team takes the time to answer questions, explain products, discuss different consumption methods, and help customers understand the differences between flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vaporizers, concentrates, tinctures, CBD products, seeds, and more. We also offer our Intro to Cannabis 101 page for your reference.

Whether you’re new to cannabis or an experienced consumer, we’re committed to providing clear, honest information so you can shop with confidence.

Cape Cod Cannabis proudly serves customers from across Cape Cod and beyond, including:

  • Provincetown
  • Truro
  • Wellfleet
  • Eastham
  • Orleans
  • Brewster
  • Harwich
  • Chatham
  • Dennis
  • Yarmouth
  • Hyannis
  • Barnstable
  • Mashpee
  • Falmouth
  • Sandwich

We also welcome thousands of visitors who make Cape Cod Cannabis a stop during their Cape Cod vacation. Conveniently located directly on Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, we’re easy to find with plenty of free parking.

We’re committed to operating responsibly while providing a safe, welcoming, and educational environment for every customer.

Our commitment includes:

  • Providing quality, licensed recreational cannabis products
  • Helping customers make informed purchasing decisions
  • Promoting responsible cannabis consumption
  • Supporting our local Cape Cod community
  • Maintaining a clean, professional, and welcoming retail environment
  • Continuously expanding our knowledge to better serve our customers

Every customer interaction is an opportunity to build trust, answer questions, and provide an exceptional experience.
